title: The False Lighthouse Flash
central_conflict: a lighthouse signal flashed toward the harbor at the wrong intervals
decisive_choice: a loose mirror on the outer railing was reflecting each beam twice
resolution: secured the mirror and tested the signal from the harbor
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a lighthouse signal flashed toward the harbor at the wrong intervals before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the lamp timer but the confusing flashes continued; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a loose mirror on the outer railing was reflecting each beam twice; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they secured the mirror and tested the signal from the harbor, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Canal Gate That Would Not Close
central_conflict: the irrigation gate would not seal before the evening release
decisive_choice: a fallen branch was wedged inside the lower track
resolution: lifted the branch with a hooked pole and closed the gate safely
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the irrigation gate would not seal before the evening release before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they tightened the handle but water still rushed beneath it; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a fallen branch was wedged inside the lower track; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they lifted the branch with a hooked pole and closed the gate safely, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
